recommended.t: Slayer cape or Slayer master cape (to teleport to Laniakea)
Some food (if you have less than 1000 life points)

rewards.t: Access to Raksha, the Shadow Colossus boss encounter.

steps.t: Talk to Laniakea, south-east in the ruins on Anachronia. [Chat: 2 The doorway at the top of the ruins. › Accept › 1 Zaros? › 3 Can we open the door somehow?]

sub.t: She is also at the ruins around the lodestone but she tells you to go to the south-east and talk to her there.
You can use option 2 on the Slayer cape to get to her quickly or teleport to Xolo City Key press | X via the Orthen teleportation device, then run south-east.

steps.t: Run west, up to the top of the stairs.
Siphon the shadow anima pools until you reach 100%.

sub.t: Completing each pool will damage you 200 points. Be aware of that in case you are on low life points.

get_inside.text: Main | Anachronia base camp tutorial

Travelling to Anachronia for the first time requires the player to use The Stormbreaker, the ship built during the Breaking the Storm event, which is located east of the Varrock Dig Site (Maplink | mapID=28 | x:3395,y:3415 | text=show on map | mtype=pin ). Players can board the ship, located on the river, to visit Anachronia. Players will be shown a cutscene the first time they travel to the island and will have to guide a group of NPCs, including an archaeologist, Laniakea, and two guards, through the island.
Agility course
Main | Anachronia Agility Course

The primary means of travel across the island is traversing the Anachronia Agility Course. This requires Agility levels 30 to 85 to traverse. The course is divided into seven sections of varying difficulty but requires level 85 Agility to complete the whole lap.
Teleports

Orthen teleportation device
Main | Orthen teleportation device
Players with at least level 90 Archaeology can unlock the Orthen Dig Site and activate the Orthen teleportation devices, allowing them to teleport to four locations across the island:
Crypt of Varanus, located near the arcane apoterrasaur hunting area
Observation outpost, located north of the pavosaurus rex hunting area
Moksha ritual site, located just east of the scimitops hunting area
Xolo city, located within the Anachronia Swamp Fortress on the south-eastern tip of the island
